newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brightpoint, Cell Therapeutics.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brightpoint, Cell Therapeutics.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said it started coverage of Cell Therapeutics Inc with a strong buy rating, citing company's development project of "one of the most exciting drug candidates in the industry: lisofylline."
-- Lisofylline is a small-molecule cancer drug currently in separate Phase II and III clinical trials.

-- Set 12-month price target of $22 per share, using 2001 earnings estimate of $1.13 per share, 35 multiple and 25 percent discount rate. Said earnings estimate assumes 1999 product launch for lisofylline.
-- UBS said it also started coverage of Brightpoint Inc with a buy rating.
-- Set earnings estimates of $0.90 per share for fiscal 1997 and $1.15 for 1998.
-- Nine-month target price is $29 per share.
-- Said company is "well-positioned globally to capitalize on changing wireless industry."
